title: Union — Combining Sets
description: Learn to combine two collections into one with distinct elements using Union.

data.text: The `Union` extension method requires two collections and returns a new collection that includes **distinct** elements from both collections combined.

data.title: Union with Primitive Types
data.content: Combining two collections with distinct elements

data.text: For complex types, you need to implement `IEqualityComparer<T>`:

data.title: Union with Custom Comparer
data.content: Combining student lists with distinct elements

data.title: Not Supported in Query Syntax
data.text: The Union operator is not supported in C# or VB.NET query syntax. Use method syntax only.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Union combines two collections into one with distinct elements
data.takeaway: Continue to the next lesson to learn about the Concat operator.
